s: ex-elBulli chefs' playful, technically dazzling tasting menu -- currently world #1
w: Three elBulli alumni -- Oriol Castro, Mateu Casañas and Eduard Xatruch -- opened Disfrutar in 2014 and built it into one of the most talked-about restaurants on the planet. The tasting menu treats technique as theatre: edible illusions, playful deconstructions, dishes built to surprise. A hidden "Secret Table" tucked in the wine cellar adds an even more exclusive, hard-to-book layer for serious diners chasing the current pinnacle of playful fine dining.
_facts: Located at Carrer de Villarroel 163, 08036 Barcelona (L'Eixample)
Opened 2014 by three former elBulli chefs: Oriol Castro, Mateu Casañas, Eduard Xatruch
Ranked #1 on the World's 50 Best Restaurants list
Offers an ultra-exclusive private tasting counter known as the "Secret Table"
